name: Ultz Pagett Flame
original_name: ウルツ・パゲット・フレイム
source:
Prince of the 'Fire Country Flame'.
He was chosen to pour power into the 'magic stone'.
A plain and simple person who has a straightforward and easy to understand personality.
Even though he's the prince of a country he is really freewheeling and can go wherever to play around whenever.
He loves eating and going to hot springs and is always together with an animal that always goes 'NyaNya'.
He's friends with Cepio.
